searchText: https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8369#constants Ah thanks - I missed that 🙏 What is the status of eip-8369? it's an informational EIP so it's a bit of a weird one, the most important thing is to integrate parts of it into FOCIL and Frames interactions imo Without those per-tx and per-IL gas limits it is realistic to use inclusion lists adversarially. Having the limits mitigates the problem by bounding the amount of work an IL can add to a builder. So would be good to have them as part of the spec 👍
